The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] founded an '''elite assassination corps''' following their defeat at the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The corps was intended to help the Trade Federation seek revenge against the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], as the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] had played a key role in securing the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] victory against the company. The [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] corps ultimately failed in its goals.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The assassination corps was first mentioned in the DataBank entry for the Trade Federation in [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']], the [[2002]] expansion to the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.<ref name="GB" />
